  userId       String
  batchId      String
  konsentrasi  Konsentrasi    // ONLINE | OFFLINE
  user         User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  batch        Batch          @relation(fields: [batchId], references: [id])
  progresses   Progress[]
  absensi      Absensi[]
  tugasSubmits TugasSubmit[]

  @@unique([userId, batchId])
}

enum Konsentrasi {
  ONLINE
  OFFLINE
}

model Materi {
  id         String     @id @default(cuid())
  batchId    String
  urutan     Int
  judul      String
  deskripsi  String?
  videoUrl   String?
  pdfUrl     String?
  durasi     Int // dalam detik
  tipe       TipeMateri // MATERI | KUIS
  batch      Batch      @relation(fields: [batchId], references: [id])
  progresses Progress[]
  soals      Soal[]     // hanya jika tipe KUIS
}

enum TipeMateri {
  MATERI
  KUIS
}

model Soal {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  materiId String
  teks     String
  pilihanA String
  pilihanB String
  pilihanC String
  pilihanD String
  jawaban  String // "A" | "B" | "C" | "D"
  bahas    String?
  materi   Materi  @relation(fields: [materiId], references: [id])
}

model Progress {
  id             String     @id @default(cuid())
  enrollmentId   String
  materiId       String
  watchedSeconds Int        @default(0)
  completed      Boolean    @default(false)
  nilaiKuis      Int?
  completedAt    DateTime?
  enrollment     Enrollment @relation(fields: [enrollmentId], references: [id])
  materi         Materi     @relation(fields: [materiId], references: [id])

  @@unique([enrollmentId, materiId])
}

model Sesi {
  id         String         @id @default(cuid())
  batchId    String
  urutan     Int
  nama       String
  tanggal    DateTime
  jamMulai   DateTime
  jamSelesai DateTime
  lokasi     String
  alamat     String
  instruktur String
  qrToken    String         @unique @default(cuid())
  batch      Batch          @relation(fields: [batchId], references: [id])
  absensi    Absensi[]
  materials  SesiMaterial[]
  tugas      Tugas?
}

model SesiMaterial {
  id       String @id @default(cuid())
  sesiId   String
  namaFile String
  url      String
  sesi     Sesi   @relation(fields: [sesiId], references: [id])
}

model Absensi {
  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  enrollmentId String
  sesiId       String
  hadir        Boolean    @default(false)
  waktuScan    DateTime?
  enrollment   Enrollment @relation(fields: [enrollmentId], references: [id])
  sesi         Sesi       @relation(fields: [sesiId], references: [id])

  @@unique([enrollmentId, sesiId])
}

model Tugas {
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  sesiId    String        @unique
  nama      String
  instruksi String?
  deadline  DateTime
  sesi      Sesi          @relation(fields: [sesiId], references: [id])
  submits   TugasSubmit[]
}

model TugasSubmit {
  id           String      @id @default(cuid())
  enrollmentId String
  tugasId      String
  fileUrl      String
  submittedAt  DateTime    @default(now())
  nilai        Int?
  feedback     String?
  status       StatusTugas @default(SUBMITTED)
  enrollment   Enrollment  @relation(fields: [enrollmentId], references: [id])
  tugas        Tugas       @relation(fields: [tugasId], references: [id])

  @@unique([enrollmentId, tugasId])
}

enum StatusTugas {
  SUBMITTED
  DINILAI
  REVISI
}
